network_enforcement: The checker makes no network request. It hash-binds the narrow runner and the integrated validation receipt, and verifies the separately recorded current-turn run, which executed every Lean process through Bubblewrap with --unshare-net and a read-only root while writing compiled outputs only to a fresh temporary directory. This does not turn the shared warm pinned dependency cache into release-grade cold hermetic evidence.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line PASS/BLOCKED release status summary

scope_boundary: Worker-side negative release reconciliation plus current network-isolated, temporary-directory, warm-cache Lean replay. This recipe cannot provide dependency or master acceptance, accepted H0/R0 or trust/provenance closure, immutable clean empty-cache cold build, offline restoration, complete SBOM/licenses, distinct signed runners, an independently implemented verifier, protected release CI, or a deterministic release bundle.
